liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): The stolen tape was labeled as an original version of this song [6]
- **Trumpet Solo (Robert Hunter)** (1 review): Hunter confirmed on a Deadnet forum that he plays the trumpet solo; the tape was stolen at his party [6]
- **Uncle John's Band Jam** (1 review): Reviewer finds this jam rewarding: a calypso-flavored rave-up that builds and repeats, conveying the joy of creation [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Trumpet Solo (Robert Hunter)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Dead Or Alive**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Train Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **No Eggs Today**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Uncle John's Band Jam**: rare: 9 archived performances [10]
- **quick, the baby is crying**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **unidentified guitar**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Friend Of The Devil [10]

## The recordings

- **gd69-06-xx.aud.tzuriel.10510.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 9 songs; 29 min; rated 3.38/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Cheap microphone into a portable recorder; acoustic material remains interesting, but the electric material is too distorted to enjoy; Some distortion in the sound, but the reviewer insists it is still enjoyable [2][3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the band was actually in Boston at the Tea Party on this date, closing a three-show run, so these home recordings can't be from then [4]
- Reviewer notes that December 31 serves as a placeholder date for unknown or disputed recordings [5]
- Here the band plays Friend of the Devil in straight 4/4 while working out verse meter; by 12/4/69 they dropped in 3/4 measures, so this predates it [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-06-xx.aud.tzuriel.10510.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Tzuriel; source: Audience - Home Recordings [1]
